Agent Name: ResultVerification_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: They proposed an incorrect methodology to answer the question, using an ImageNet EfficientNet classifier and counting labels containing the substring "bird" from top-5 predictions. This approach is flawed because (a) ImageNet is a single-label classifier per image and cannot detect multiple species simultaneously, (b) bird class labels typically don’t include the word “bird,” so the filter would miss valid species, and (c) species-level identification and simultaneous counts require an object detection/multi-label pipeline or manual review. This led the process toward an incorrect or non-actionable solution rather than producing the required highest simultaneous species count.
